title: Distribution Record
description: One completed distribution of a specific Build Artifact to Firebase App Distribution, per spec.md's Distribution Record entity. TWO INDEPENDENT AXES (LVA-148, renamed 2026-08-26): `app` says WHICH APPLICATION was distributed; `build_variant` says WHICH BUILD VARIANT of it. Both were previously called `channel`, in this contract and in scripts/firebase-distribute.sh respectively, which made one word name two concepts in artifacts that are read together. Neither axis may be substituted for the other, and no property here is named `channel` any more.

artifact_id.description: Which Build Artifact this distributes. It encodes BOTH axes in one token; `app` and `build_variant` below decompose it, and the allOf invariants keep all three in agreement.

app.description: AXIS A — which of the two Android applications was distributed: the user client (:app) or the on-device API server (:api-app). Named `app` after this codebase's own existing word for the axis — `--app client|api-app` and SELECTED_APP in scripts/firebase-distribute.sh, --app/APP in scripts/pipeline/phase-05a-changelog-entry.sh, and the `app-`/`api-app-` prefixes of artifact_id above. The VALUES are unchanged by the LVA-148 rename because they are also the on-disk evidence-directory names under .lava-ci-evidence/distribute-changelog/. NOT a build variant: `debug` and `release` are NOT valid here.

build_variant.description: AXIS B — which build variant of that application was distributed. Named `build_variant` after this codebase's own existing word for the axis — buildTypes/`variant` throughout app/build.gradle.kts, the `$2=buildtype(debug|release)` parameter of _pick_apk_by_version in scripts/firebase-distribute.sh, and spec.md's own 'a specific Build Artifact variant' (§Key Entities) / FR-010 'the debug variant' / SC-005 'every distributed build variant'. This is the axis scripts/firebase-distribute.sh calls MODE, and the axis its last-version-debug / last-version-release pointers partition. NOT an application: `firebase-app-distribution` and `firebase-app-distribution-api-app` are NOT valid here.

version_code.description: MUST be strictly greater than the previously recorded distribution for this (app, build_variant) PAIR — the pairing is what the last-version-<variant> pointer inside the per-app evidence directory records. Enforced by firebase-distribute.sh's own §6.P gate, not re-implemented here.

evidence_ref.description: Path to this run's Pipeline Run Report — replaces a human attestation reference per research.md R-001.

allOf.$comment: artifact_id ⇒ app. A record claiming an api-app artifact was distributed to the client app (or vice versa) is the exact axis mix-up LVA-148 names, and is refused here rather than left to a reader to notice.
artifact_id ⇒ build_variant. This is the §6.Z/1.2.19-1039 shape in schema form: a record whose artifact is the R8-minified release APK cannot claim the debug variant.
